items.text: A fallen power line near Washington, DC flipped over 3GW of data centers onto backup power within 30 seconds, spiking PJM grid voltage and exposing AI buildout risks.
items.text_zh: 华盛顿特区附近一根电线坠落，30 秒内超 3GW 数据中心集体切换备用电源，导致 PJM 电网电压骤升，暴露 AI 数据中心扩建的电网风险。

items.text: Tencent's AI work assistant WorkBuddy launched natively on Huawei's App Gallery for HarmonyOS PCs, extending Tencent's AI productivity tools to Huawei's desktop ecosystem.
items.text_zh: 腾讯 AI 办公助手 WorkBuddy 原生适配鸿蒙电脑并上架华为 App Gallery，将腾讯 AI 生产力工具带入华为桌面生态。

items.text: China produced 18.58 million service robots in 2025, up 16.1% year on year, according to official statistics.
items.text_zh: 官方数据显示，2025 年中国服务机器人产量达 1858.1 万套，同比增长 16.1%。

items.text: D2iQ co-founder Tobi Knaup argues open-weight AI is having its 'Kubernetes moment,' noting Chinese models drew 41% of Hugging Face downloads and urging US labs to open frontier weights.
items.text_zh: D2iQ 联合创始人 Tobi Knaup 撰文称开源权重 AI 正迎来“Kubernetes 时刻”：中国模型已占 Hugging Face 下载量的 41%，呼吁美国实验室开放前沿模型权重。

items.text: SCMP examines whether 'supernode' architectures that densely interconnect hundreds of domestic AI chips can break China's compute bottlenecks under US export controls.
items.text_zh: 《南华早报》分析“超节点”架构——将数百颗国产 AI 芯片高密度互联——能否突破美国出口管制下中国的算力瓶颈。

items.text: 3D-generation startup Tripo posted a SIGGRAPH 2026 recap, reporting week-long artist and developer traffic at its booth after keynoting on generative 3D and world models.
items.text_zh: 3D 生成公司 Tripo 发布 SIGGRAPH 2026 回顾：在发表生成式 3D 与世界模型主题演讲后，其展台整周吸引艺术家与开发者到访交流。
